Our Locations

ICTS offers a unique balance of innovation, technology and operational expertise, to provide mission-critical security.

Effective security is vital to ensuring the resilience and continuity of your business operations. Four decades of consistent organic growth and exceptional client retention have established ICTS Europe as the leading provider of bespoke professional security solutions with global service capability. Select ICTS as your security partner, and you have a partner you can rely on. 

Our Solutions

People to Trust

ICTS Europe is first and foremost a team. Our greatest strength is the commitment, the integrity and the skills of our people.

Value Through Technology

Innovation and technology is how we keep ahead of the game. The solutions we develop enable our clients to achieve better security at optimal cost.

Canine Worldwide

We are the world’s leading canine solutions specialists. Our K9 teams and expertise protect people and infrastructure on three continents.

Latest News

Pioneering Employment Initiative in the Security Sector

ICTS Cyprus, a member of the international ICTS Europe Group, announces an innovative employment support program in the field of private security, offering a €1,000 net Hiring Bonus to new Security Guards who join the company by April 30, 2026.

ICTS Deutschland grows in Munich

ICTS Deutschland GmbH (100% subsidiary of ICTS Europe) has been awarded the contract as a subcontractor for the provision of security services (§8 and §9 LuftSiG) at Munich Airport.

Read More

ICTS Spain at the forefront of helping the citizens of Valencia

On November 4, ICTS Spain delivered essential supplies—including diapers, hygiene products, baby food, milk, and pet food—to Valencia, distributing them to those most in need.
